description: Upper bound on k for the paper's pin design: pin = 2.210 mm UO2 pellet + 0.254 mm He gap + 0.316 mm HT-9 clad (rod OD 3.350 mm), rods packed as tightly as geometrically possible (pitch = rod diameter, touching rods, reflective boundary). No hexagonal pin bundle built from these pins can reach a higher fuel volume fraction, so this k is an upper bound for any assembly made of these pins at the same enrichment.
